services.name: UFO Parasail
services.desc: Kona parasailing tours are one of the top things to do on the Big Island, offering breathtaking views of the Kona coastline. With UFO Parasail, you’ll soar 800 to 1,200 feet of line above the Pacific Ocean, enjoying the peaceful silence of flight before an optional, refreshing UFO dip in crystal-clear waters. Each Kona parasailing tour lasts up to 60 minutes and takes place on USCG-certified boats built for comfort and performance. While our vessels can accommodate up to 10 passengers, we limit shared trips to 8 guests for a smoother, more personalized experience. services.name: Sport Fishing
services.desc: Our inshore bottom fishing trips are top recommended for those looking for more action and hoping to be more involved with hooking and landing our inshore species. Operated closer to shore in Maui’s calm executive waters, they are also great for families with children and those that don’t need a full day out on the water. We offer shared trips that are 4 and 5 hour durations and private options from 4-6 hours depending on your preference. Our captain will try and catch bait in the morning then travel a short distance to our inside reefs. We use a variety of live and dead bait with occasionally artificial lures. The Captain will clean and fillet your catch if desired. UFO Fishing trips

services.name: Banana Boat
services.desc: Experience a fun, fast-paced banana boat ride off Kaanapali Beach, perfect for families, friends, and groups looking for a splash of adventure. This nonstop 20-minute ride delivers plenty of excitement, with ocean spray, laughter, and stunning views across the channel to Lānaʻi and Molokaʻi. Your adventure begins right on the sand with convenient beach pickup. A U.S. Coast Guard-licensed crew handles all safety briefings and operations, so you can simply hop on, hold tight, and enjoy the ride. Experience the incredible views as you parasail over Maui. services.name: Private Whale Watch
services.desc: Join us for an unforgettable private whale watching adventure aboard our powerful 30’ premium speed boat. Designed for comfort and excitement, this 12-passenger vessel gives your group front-row access to one of nature’s most awe-inspiring shows - the annual migration of Maui’s humpback whales. Enjoy the freedom of a fully private charter, reserved exclusively for your party. Customize your trip, soak in breathtaking coastal views, and share an intimate encounter with Maui’s incredible marine life - all without waiting, crowds, or schedules. blurb: UFO Parasail offers parasailing experiences where guests can fly alone, tandem, or three at a time, enjoying panoramic views of the Pacific and Hawaiian islands. Parasailing is easy, fun, and suitable for guests aged 5 and up. They also offer sport fishing, whale watching tours, and banana boat rides.

quotes.author: <strong>Claude P.
quotes.text: This is a seriously fun activity. But the team at UFO made it so much better. If you haven't parasailed before, this is the team you want. Their instructions were calm, confident and simple. Their execution was flawless. Most of all, they really know what they are doing and have a lot of fun doing it.

quotes.author: <strong>Kelly M.
quotes.text: The crew was absolutely amazing! Our ride was incredible. Super smooth going out and coming back in. Since it had been my birthday a few days prior, the crew gave us a few 'birthday dunks' prior to coming back into the boat. I cannot say enough good things about this crew and the trip!

quotes.author: <strong>Amanda A.
quotes.text: If you’ve been thinking about parasailing ? do it! I was super nervous about it. Ty and I believe his name was Cory did an amazing job! Super fun and professional!! They totally made the experience much better! Thanks guys ?

quotes.author: <strong>Jodi A.
quotes.text: My daughter and I had a great time flying. We ended up being the only ones on the boat. The people that took us know made us fell safe even thought the water was rough. It was so fun would do it again.
